subject: Request: temporary no-PO route for SolarFlare pilot
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@solarflare.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@solarflare.io
Date: 2028-05-21T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — excited to kick off the 3-month pilot. Our finance team prefers billing by invoice for pilots under $25k rather than issuing a PO. Can Redwood accept invoice-only for this initial phase? If you need, I can attach our W9 and the SOW.

Anita
Anita Shah
Head of Partnerships, SolarFlare Energy
---
Attachments: solarflare_W9.pdf (pdf), pilot_statement_of_work_v1.docx (docx)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Anita Shah <anita@solarflare.io>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, priy a_natarajan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Hi Anita — welcome!

Short answer: we can consider an invoice-only path for short pilots but need Finance and Procurement sign-off, and a few guardrails (monthly cap, payment terms, evidence checklist). I’ve looped in Markus (Procure) and Priya (Vendor intake) to kick off internal review. Laura — can Finance greenlight a sub-$25k invoice lane for a 90-day pilot with standard payment terms (Net30) and an agreed SOW?

Next steps I suggest:
- Priya to validate vendor docs and risk tier
- Markus to confirm exception path and required approvals
- Laura to confirm payment terms and any required holdbacks

Anita — I’ll follow up with the exact list of docs we need and the expected timeline for approval.

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: priy a_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-21T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Thanks — I reviewed the attachments. Vendor information looks complete for an initial intake (W9 present, SOW attached). Risk classification: low-medium — no infra access required, usage limited to hosted endpoints. Recommend a conditional "invoice-only" onboarding with these controls:

- Pilot cap: $25,000 total spend
- Monthly cap: $10,000
- Evidence: W9, SOW, point-of-contact, support SLA in SOW
- Billing cadence: monthly invoice, Net30
- Expiration: 90 days from start date; automatic reversion to PO-mandatory unless Procurement approves extension

If Procurement signs off we can create vendor record and allow invoices. Markus — can you confirm the approval chain and whether a single manager approval is sufficient for this tier?

Priya
Vendor Ops

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, priy a_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-21T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Folks — I agree with Priya's controls. For the approval chain: for low-medium risk and spend <$25k, Procurement can approve with manager-level sign-off + Finance acknowledgment. We will apply an "invoice-only temporary" flag in our vendor portal with the caps you outlined. A couple operational notes:

- We need a single line in the SOW stating this pilot is limited in scope and cost cap, otherwise AP will insist on PO. Can the SOW be updated?
- We should add a clause for credit hold if invoice aging exceeds 60 days (protects Redwood).

Laura — do you want to authorize the manager-level approval or should this go up to VP Finance?

Markus
Procurement Manager

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, priy a_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Thanks for the summary. I can authorize a temporary invoice-only lane for single pilots under $25k if the following are true:
1) SOW explicitly caps monthly and total spend and references the pilot start/end dates.
2) SolarFlare provides W9 and primary billing contact (done).
3) AP will be given a consolidated invoice each month and Redwood will set up a spend alert to pause API keys if invoices are 45+ days overdue.

Markus — manager approval is fine for this case. Please document the exception and note that any extension beyond 90 days requires VP sign-off. Priya — proceed with vendor record creation once SOW is updated and signed.

Laura
Director, Finance

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Anita Shah <anita@solarflare.io>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, priy a_natarajan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-22T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Anita — good news: we can do invoice-only for the 90-day pilot with the controls Finance/Procurement outlined. Two quick asks to move forward:

1) Can SolarFlare add a single sentence to the SOW: "Pilot is capped at $25,000 total and $10,000 per month; invoicing will be monthly with Net30 terms."
2) Please confirm billing contact and attach signed SOW if possible.

Once we have the updated SOW I’ll route for manager approval and Priya will create the vendor record and enable the temporary invoice-only flag. We’ll also email a DocuSign link for the SOW.

Best,
Sergio

From: Anita Shah <anita@solarflare.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@solarflare.io
Date: 2028-05-23T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & PO question

Thanks everyone — we updated the SOW and attached a signed copy. Billing contact: Tanya Lopez <tanya.lopez@solarflare.io>.

I attached the signed SOW and the W9 again. Please let me know if you need anything else; we’re aiming to start the pilot on June 1.

Anita
